quest.title: Wangshu Take-Away
quest.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Well aren't you a busy one? No problem, I'll get someone else to help me out.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Well, aren't you straightforward... Well, best hurry, then — and <color=#00E1FFFF>be sure not to touch any weird stuff while you're at it</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Right, and remember <color=#00E1FFFF>not to use your glider to rush things</color>. If you scatter the meat rolls when you land, the customer isn't taking it.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm hungry... *sigh* I wonder where my order's gone off too?

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here at last. Thanks a lot!

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: I was just thinking that I should head back to Wangshu Inn to check in on my order, too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What, you here to lend me a hand?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Well, you're just in time. Someone named Ling'guan ordered a Matsutake Meat Roll from me.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: She wanted me to send it to some spot northwest of Dihua Marsh. The Mora's already been paid out, too.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Well, if you've got time, how about helping me deliver it? You'll be compensated.

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm hungry... *sigh* I wonder where my order's gone off too?
